The chart depicts the distribution of enterprises by number, number of persons employed, and turnover across four different industries: construction, trade, and services in 2021. 

The number of enterprises in the construction industry accounts for 61% of the total, followed by trade at 12%, other services at 7%, and the industry sector at 2%. In terms of employment, the construction industry employs the highest percentage of persons at 39%, with trade employing 22%, other services at 09%, and the industry sector at 11%. Lastly, when it comes to turnover, the trade sector dominates at 31%, followed by construction at 16%, other services at 61%, and the industry sector at 05%. 

Each sector within the chart is color-coded, and percentages are provided within each sector. The sectors are arranged clockwise from the construction industry at the top left, moving down to trade, to other services, and finally the industry sector at the top right. The chart does not include a legend, but the industry sector is labeled as the last sector in each pie or donut chart where it appears.
